title: Prospective equal-count source proximity and diversity experiment
status: prospectively amended conditional future experiment; not launched

amendment.reason: The original two-arm target-near versus maximin-diverse comparison changed source-target proximity and within-source diversity simultaneously. It could rank the two selection strategies, but it could not identify proximity as the cause of a difference.
amendment.correction: Promote the already frozen random anchor to a scored third arm. Its within-source diversity differs from the target-near arm by only 0.14%, while it is about 30% farther from both target families, providing the clean proximity contrast that the two-arm design lacked.
amendment.information_boundary: This correction was made before launch and without inspecting any convergence-extension result, SHIFT-SUV validation or test geometry, flow field, or adaptation metric.

information_boundary: The source subsets use only DrivAerML training geometries and the frozen SHIFT-SUV target-training geometries. No SHIFT-SUV validation or test geometry, flow field, adaptation metric, or convergence-extension result was inspected.
scientific_question: Holding the source PDE family, source-example count, and target adaptation protocol fixed, does target proximity predict reusable source knowledge, and can a diversity-maximizing source strategy overcome a large proximity disadvantage?

input.descriptor: The frozen 15-dimensional scale-free, area-weighted surface-position and surface-normal descriptor, standardized by the full DrivAerML training distribution.

instrument_calibration.status: Exploratory calibration used to choose a source-set size before any adaptation outcome.
instrument_calibration.reason: This retains 44% of the available source vehicles while preserving an opposed treatment contrast larger than 10% in source diversity and 25% in source-target distance.

target_near.selection: Greedily minimize the mean of the energy distances to the estate and fastback target-training distributions. Start empty; at each step add the candidate giving the smallest joint objective. Sort candidates lexicographically by case ID before selection, which supplies the tie break.

maximin_diverse.selection: Choose the source case nearest the full-source centroid first, then repeatedly add the candidate whose nearest selected neighbor is farthest away. Sort candidates lexicographically by case ID before selection, which supplies the tie break.

random_anchor.selection: NumPy default_rng seed 20260733, sample 192 source cases without replacement from lexicographically sorted case IDs.

instrument_calibration.contrast: Relative to the maximin set, the target-near set is 26.5% closer to estate and 25.0% closer to fastback; the maximin set has 11.4% larger within-source pair distance. Relative to the random anchor, the target-near set is 29.7% closer to estate and 30.1% closer to fastback while its within-source pair distance differs by only 0.14%.
instrument_calibration.sampling_stability: The ordering survives both independent descriptor samples: the target-near construction remains closer to each target and the maximin construction remains more diverse.

rival_hypotheses.proximity: The target-near source checkpoint adapts materially better than the diversity-matched random anchor on both target families; beating the maximin-diverse checkpoint would further show that proximity dominates the opposed strategy contrast.
rival_hypotheses.diversity: The maximin-diverse checkpoint adapts materially better than the target-near checkpoint on both target families despite its roughly 25% larger source-target morphology distance.
rival_hypotheses.both_contribute: Target-near and maximin-diverse each materially beat the random anchor, but neither materially beats the other on both target families.
rival_hypotheses.conditional_relation: The ordering reverses across target families, so neither proximity nor diversity is a broad source-selection law.
rival_hypotheses.source_distribution_null: The stabilized ordering is smaller than the materiality threshold; changing which DrivAerML vehicles are seen does not explain the reusable signal.

activation_policy.if_full_source_half_label_succeeds: Defer this experiment until the positive result survives independent target seeds and source checkpoints.
activation_policy.if_full_source_half_label_fails_but_same: First quantify the label-equivalent saving. Activate this experiment only if improving that persistent gain remains the highest-value question.
activation_policy.if_full_source_same_budget_gain_does_not: Activate this as the smallest controlled test of whether source distribution can create reusable information rather than a transient initialization advantage.

staged_test.stage_one: Use GeoTransolver as the source-relation instrument and score all three frozen source sets: target-near, maximin-diverse, and random-anchor. The completed parent pilot showed the larger same-budget pretraining response for this model. This stage cannot support an architectural claim.
staged_test.stage_two: Only if one source relation wins materially for GeoTransolver, repeat the identical frozen three-arm source contrast with MeshTransformer to test whether boundary-aware structure changes that relation.
controls: Use exactly 192 source cases in each of the three source conditions.
Match source-example exposures, target examples, target-update counts, optimizer-selection protocol, and fixed validation cases.
Use the same frozen target-training subsets and compare only after the existing plateau and learning-rate-boundary gates pass.
Report source validation quality as a possible mediator; do not post-hoc equalize it by changing compute.

prospective_decision_rules.proximity_effect: At the final matched target-update budget, target-near pressure error divided by random-anchor pressure error is <= 0.95 on both target families in both full-validation and cross-fit reductions, with no more than 10% wall-shear-stress degradation.
prospective_decision_rules.proximity_dominates_opposed_strategy: The proximity-effect gate passes and target-near pressure error divided by maximin-diverse pressure error is <= 0.95 on both target families in both reductions, with the same wall-shear-stress guard.
prospective_decision_rules.diversity_favored_strategy: Maximin-diverse pressure error divided by both target-near and random-anchor pressure error is <= 0.95 on both target families in both reductions, with no more than 10% wall-shear-stress degradation. This supports the diversity-maximizing strategy but does not estimate a pure diversity main effect.
prospective_decision_rules.both_contribute: The proximity-effect gate passes and maximin-diverse materially beats random-anchor on both families, while the target-near versus maximin-diverse comparison is smaller than 5% or reverses by family.
prospective_decision_rules.conditional: The material ordering reverses between estate and fastback.
prospective_decision_rules.null_or_inconclusive: No three-arm pattern above passes after optimization stabilizes. Estimate seed uncertainty before distinguishing a small effect from a null.
prospective_decision_rules.test_policy: No SHIFT-SUV test result is opened for this experiment.

literature_audit.outcome: Prior evidence supports both rivals, so the controlled contrast remains genuinely discriminating.

sources.finding: Similarity-selected source subsets can outperform using all available source data in metal-additive-manufacturing regression.
sources.bearing: Supports the proximity rival, but not in PDE operator learning.

sources.finding: Mixed-physics pretraining can yield large downstream data savings across PDE tasks.
sources.bearing: Supports broad-source reuse, but does not isolate proximity from diversity at equal source count.

sources.finding: Distribution-aware transfer improves operator learning under geometry and dynamics shifts.
sources.bearing: Shows that matching the target conditional distribution can matter, but changes the transfer objective rather than only the source set.

sources.finding: Diverse geometry sources usually improve adaptation and reduce labeled-data needs in industrial surrogate tasks.
sources.bearing: Supports the diversity rival, while source diversity and other source factors remain partly confounded.

literature_audit.novelty_boundary: The intended contribution is not a new data-selection algorithm. It is an equal-count, same-PDE test of a clean target-proximity contrast plus an opposed proximity-versus-diversity source-selection strategy for geometry-bearing boundary-driven surrogates.

claim_limit: The target-near versus random-anchor contrast identifies the effect of the frozen proximity selection at essentially matched measured diversity. The maximin-diverse comparisons rank a diversity-maximizing strategy but do not identify a pure diversity main effect because target distance is not matched. The design remains within one external-flow dataset and does not establish a universal source-selection law or isolate response-physics differences across datasets.
